criteria.description: A game starts only with 3 to 6 distinct players and a track length from 10 to 60; seat 1 tells the first story
Each round's points come from the scoring engine, and totals add up across rounds
criteria.verification: game.test.ts applyRound: two rounds, totals equal the sum of scoreRound results; 3 players use THREE_PLAYER_RULES

criteria.description: The storyteller rotates in seat order and wraps; after a changed storyteller, rotation follows on from them
A voter is never offered their own card; the storyteller's card is offered
criteria.verification: game.test.ts voteChoices; manual: round entry shows no chip with the voter's own name

criteria.description: The game is over when a total reaches the track length or after End game; tied leaders share the win

The setup screen starts a game from a group in one tap or from tapped players, adds a player inline, reorders seats by drag and by up/down, sets track length, notes the 3-player rules, and marks the players as recently used
criteria.verification: manual in Chrome at 390 px: each step done; Players screen lists the game's players first afterwards

criteria.description: Round entry, review with reasons, score list and winner screen work one-handed in portrait, and Resume returns to a game left for the home screen
criteria.verification: manual in Chrome at 390 px and 320 px, light and dark: full game to the winner screen by track length and by End game; Home then Resume; no sideways scroll; tap targets at least 48 px

criteria.description: The plan manifest shows prompts 2, 3 and 5 completed and prompt 4 in progress with its branch, folder and PR
Typecheck, tests and build pass locally and in CI on the PR
criteria.verification: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build locally; gh pr checks green
